title: The unique centered pulse maximizing the Dirichlet Schrödinger zeta determinant under a nonnegative L1 mass budget
author: Clara L. Aldana; Jean-Baptiste Caillau; Pedro Freitas
work: Maximal determinants of Schrödinger operators on bounded intervals
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.128

original_source_record.kind: Original vector PDF diagram clipped without captions; proof and mathematical prose remain editable TeX.

difficulty_reason: Pontryagin switching-function analysis excludes interior zero and saturated arcs and proves a singular-pulse structure. Stationary optimizers of bounded-control approximations establish existence despite the noncompact L1 budget, and an unbounded-control maximum principle gives global uniqueness.
